Snubjaw is a kobold grubtender located in the Chittering Den in the Ringing Deeps. Snubjaw and Nebb were tending to their grubs when invasive undercrawlers attacked them and poisoned Snubjaw. Nebb asked an adventurer to place candles around their barricade to ward them. He then tasked them with gathering venom so he could make an antidote for Snubjaw, but Snubjaw insisted they rescue the other grubtenders and the harvest instead. When they tried to use the antidote on Snubjaw, the venom wasn't strong enough, so Nebb suggested they use the queen's venom. Since arriving, they both lived in Dunelle's Kindness for years. Barahl described her as a strong person. One year before the war in Khaz Algar, Sophietta left to follow her dream of being one of airship captains or at least joining an airship crew. Arriving at the academy, Sophietta put in a lot of work to excel in order to become a captain and was top of her class. Soul-Cracking Dreamcatcher is a curio for Valeera Sanguinar during Midnight Season 2. The baseline version is found in low-tier delves, and higher-rank versions are found in higher-tier delves, all the way up to the Rank 4 version in Tier 8 delves. Rank 5 can be obtained from the Labyrinth of Kindo'jan after reaching rank 1 in Kindo'jan's Labyrinth Journey.
